Particle Filter Positioning for Acoustic Telemetry

Source: R/2.0_function_particle_filter.R
particle_filter_positioning.Rd

Estimates fish positions using a Sequential Monte Carlo (particle filter) approach. Particles represent possible fish locations and are propagated forward using a Correlated Random Walk, then weighted by detection likelihood at each time step.

Usage

particle_filter_positioning(
  detection_data,
  station_info,
  de_model,
  raster,
  n_particles = 1000,
  step_length_mean = 50,
  step_length_sd = 30,
  turning_angle_sd = 45,
  time_step = 180,
  max_distance = 30000,
  fish_id_col = "path_id",
  time_col = "datetime",
  station_col = "station_id",
  ess_threshold = 0.5,
  return_particles = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

detection_data

Data frame of detections with columns for fish ID, time, station ID, and detection status.

station_info

Data frame or sf object with station coordinates and depths.

de_model

A fitted detection efficiency model.

raster

A RasterLayer defining the study area. NA cells are barriers.

n_particles

Integer. Number of particles per fish (default 1000).

step_length_mean

Numeric. Mean step length in metres per time_step seconds (default 50).

step_length_sd

Numeric. SD of step length (default 30).

turning_angle_sd

Numeric. SD of turning angle in degrees (default 45).

time_step

Numeric. Reference time step in seconds for movement scaling (default 180).

max_distance

Numeric. Maximum DE lookup distance in metres (default 30000).

fish_id_col

Character. Name of fish ID column (default "path_id").

time_col

Character. Name of time column (default "datetime").

station_col

Character. Name of station ID column (default "station_id").

ess_threshold

Numeric. ESS threshold for resampling as fraction of n_particles (default 0.5).

return_particles

Logical. Return full particle histories (default FALSE).

verbose

Logical. Print progress (default TRUE).

Value

A list with components:

positions

Data frame with weighted mean position estimates per fish/time

particles

(Optional) Data frame with all particle positions and weights
